field_updates.detail: "Forward Current vs. Forward Voltage", Hyper Red, "Ta = 25 °C" (linear 0-50 mA vs 1.5-2.5 V). Read points: 0.81 mA @ 1.723 V (resid +4.6 mV); 1.34 mA @ 1.748 V (resid -0.9 mV); 2.15 mA @ 1.773 V (resid -4.6 mV); 2.96 mA @ 1.798 V (resid +0.4 mV); 4.03 mA @ 1.818 V (resid +0.2 mV); 4.84 mA @ 1.828 V (resid -2.0 mV); 5.65 mA @ 1.838 V (resid -2.7 mV); 8.00 mA @ 1.863 V (resid -3.0 mV); 9.34 mA @ 1.878 V (resid +0.1 mV); 10.95 mA @ 1.893 V (resid +2.3 mV); 12.84 mA @ 1.908 V (resid +4.0 mV); 15.26 mA @ 1.923 V (resid +3.6 mV); 20.03 mA @ 1.948 V (resid +2.2 mV); 24.87 mA @ 1.968 V (resid -1.2 mV); 29.91 mA @ 1.988 V (resid -3.2 mV). Cross-check: model VF(20 mA)=1.946 V vs stated typ 1.95 V (-4 mV); "Forward Voltage IF = 20mA VF Hyper Red 1.95 2.5 V" (p2). Method: Curve read from the PDF vector polyline vertices (pdftocairo -svg), axes calibrated from gridlines; vertices with I >= 0.8 mA used (current quantised at ~0.27 mA by the drawing, so sub-mA vertices dropped). Least-squares fit of V = N*Vt*ln(I/IS) + I*RS (linear in N*Vt, N*Vt*ln IS, RS), Vt = kT/q at 25 C = 0.02569 V. Fit 15 points 0.81-29.9 mA, rms 2.7 mV. Window sensitivity: lower bound 0.8/1.3/2/5 mA gives N 2.22-3.01, RS 0.9-2.3 ohm. IS, N and RS are strongly correlated and must be used together as one set; individually they are not identified by this curve. If used in a .model with TNOM=27 C, re-reference IS or set TNOM=25.
